courier-relay/protocol-agreement: Courier Relay protocol agreement (standing, applies to count and summary): protocol 2 is current, so omitted protocol selects "2"; explicit "1" and "2" remain supported and responses report the version actually used. Protocol 1 identifies deliveries by (account_id, delivery_id) and accepts the earliest occurred_at UTC instant, breaking equal-instant ties by smallest record_id. Protocol 2 identifies deliveries globally by delivery_id alone, accepts the latest occurred_at UTC instant, and breaks equal-instant ties by smallest record_id. Protocol 2 applies to the complete supplied set regardless of receipt dates. Source: approved provider contract in Beads issue trial-1yw.
